items.title: Snap’s 2 Big Problems That Scream ‘Stay Away From the Stock’
items.summary: Snap  stock popped after it reported earnings, but soon crackled as the gains disappeared.  Shares of Snap initially jumped 15% on Tuesday following its earnings release, as investors cheered stronger-than-expected revenue and earnings.  All the growth is coming from the rest of the world, but those users aren’t very valuable, with average revenue per user (ARPU) of just $1, versus $10.26 in North America.
